people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

translations.web: Now when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, “We will surely tell the king of all these words.”
translations.bsb: When they had heard all these words, they turned to one another in fear and said to Baruch, “Surely we must report all these words to the king.”
translations.kjv: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
translations.asv: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
